title: The Last Alibi Revisited
author: Coral Sandoval
blurb: Ivo Okafor, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
